hindi: समिधा से अग्नि की सेवा करो, घृत से अतिथि को जगाओ; इसमें हव्य पदार्थों की आहुति दो।
english: Serve Agni with the kindling-stick; awaken the guest with ghee; into him offer the oblations.
lines_deva: स॒मिधा॒ऽग्निं दु॑वस्यत घृतैर्बो॑धय॒ताति॑थिम् । आस्मि॑न् ह॒व्या जु॑होतन
lines_iast: sa̱midhā̱'gniṃ dṷvasyata ghṛtairbo̭dhaya̱tāti̭thim | āsmi̭n ha̱vyā jṷhotana

hindi: भली प्रकार प्रज्वलित ज्वाला के लिए तीव्र घृत की आहुति दो, जातवेदा अग्नि के लिए।
english: To the well-kindled flame offer sharp ghee, to Agni Jātavedas.
lines_deva: सुस॑मिद्धाय शो॒चिषे॑ घृ॒तं ती॒व्रं जु॑होतन । अ॒ग्नये॑ जा॒तवे॑दसे
lines_iast: susa̭middhāya śo̱ciṣḙ ghṛ̱taṃ tī̱vraṃ jṷhotana | a̱gnayḙ jā̱tavḙdase

hindi: हे अङ्गिरा, उस तुझको हम समिधाओं और घृत से बढ़ाते हैं; हे सबसे युवा, ऊँचा प्रज्वलित हो।
english: You, O Aṅgiras, we make grow with kindling-sticks and with ghee; blaze high, O youngest one.
notes: śocā shows metrical lengthening of the impv. śoca; bṛhacchocā = bṛhat + śocā (t + ś > cch).
lines_deva: तं त्वा॑ स॒मिद्भि॑रङ्गिरो घृ॒तेन॑ वर्धयामसि । बृ॒हच्छो॑चा यविष्ठ्य
lines_iast: taṃ tvā̭ sa̱midbhi̭raṅgiro ghṛ̱tena̭ vardhayāmasi | bṛ̱haccho̭cā yaviṣṭhya

hindi: हे अग्नि, हे प्रिय, हव्य से युक्त और घृत से भीगी वे तेरे पास जाएँ; मेरी समिधाओं को स्वीकार करो।
english: Let the oblation-bearing, ghee-dripping ones go to you, O Agni, O delightful one; accept my kindling-sticks.
notes: haviṣmatīḥ and ghṛtācīḥ are feminine plural adjectives; the line does not name the noun they qualify, so none is supplied in the translation.
lines_deva: उप॑ त्वाऽग्ने ह॒विष्म॑तीर्घृ॒ताची॑र्यन्तु हर्यत । जु॒षस्व॑ स॒मिधो॒ मम॑
lines_iast: upa̭ tvā'gne ha̱viṣma̭tīrghṛ̱tācī̭ryantu haryata | ju̱ṣasva̭ sa̱midho̱ mama̭

words.gloss: O place of worship of the gods

hindi: भूः भुवः स्वः! आकाश के समान महत्ता में, पृथिवी के समान विस्तार में — हे पृथिवी, हे देवयजनि, उस तेरी पीठ पर मैं अन्न खाने वाले अग्नि को अन्न खाने के लिए स्थापित करता हूँ।
english: Bhūḥ, bhuvaḥ, svaḥ! Like the sky in greatness, like the earth in width: O Earth, O place of worship of the gods, on the back of you, that one, I set Agni the food-eater, for the eating of food.
notes: bhūmnā and varimṇā are instrumentals of respect ("in greatness", "in width"). tasyāḥ te = "of you, that one" (demonstrative with the 2nd person pronoun).
lines_deva: भूर्भुव॒ः स्वर्द्यौरि॑व भू॒म्ना पृ॑थि॒वीव॑ वरि॒म्णा । तस्या॑स्ते पृथिवि देवयजनि पृ॒ष्ठेऽग्निम॑न्ना॒दम॒न्नाद्या॒याद॑धे
lines_iast: bhūrbhuva̱ḥ svardyauri̭va bhū̱mnā pṛ̭thi̱vīva̭ vari̱mṇā | tasyā̭ste pṛthivi devayajani pṛ̱ṣṭhe'gnima̭nnā̱dama̱nnādyā̱yāda̭dhe

hindi: यह चितकबरा वृषभ आ गया है; वह माता के सामने बैठ गया है, और पिता की ओर, स्वर्ग की ओर, जाता हुआ।
english: This dappled bull has come; he has sat down before the mother, and going forth to the father, to heaven.
notes: gauḥ may be bull or cow; taken as masculine with pṛśniḥ and prayan. prayantsvaḥ: prayan + svaḥ with the inserted t of sandhi (n + s). svaḥ is read as a second object of prayan, in apposition to pitaram.
lines_deva: आयं गौः पृश्नि॑रक्रमी॒दस॑दन् मा॒तरं॑ पु॒रः । पि॒तरं॑ च प्र॒यन्त्स्व॑ः
lines_iast: āyaṃ gauḥ pṛśni̭rakramī̱dasa̭dan mā̱tara̭ṃ pu̱raḥ | pi̱tara̭ṃ ca pra̱yantsva̭ḥ

hindi: वह दीप्तिमती भीतर चलती है, इसके प्राण से बाहर श्वास छोड़ती हुई; उस महान ने आकाश को देखा।
english: The shining one moves within, breathing out from his breath; the mighty one has beheld the sky.
notes: rocanā is the feminine nominative 'the shining one', subject of carati, agreeing with apānatī; the line does not name her. asya is taken with prāṇāt ('his breath'). akhyan is akhyat (3 sg. aor. of khyā) with t > n before the m- of mahiṣaḥ. mahiṣa literally 'buffalo', here 'the mighty one'. The input line has a double space before mahiṣo, kept in src.
lines_deva: अ॒न्तश्च॑रति रोच॒नास्य प्रा॒णादपा॑न॒ती । व्य॑ख्यन्  महि॒षो दिव॑म्

hindi: यह तीस धामों पर प्रकाशित होता है; वाणी पक्षी के लिए रखी जाती है, प्रत्येक प्रभात में, निश्चय ही, दिनों के साथ।
english: It shines over thirty domains; speech is set for the bird; at each dawning, indeed, with the days.

text_flags.why: the printed Devanagari त्रि॒jशद्धाम॒ contains a stray Latin letter "j" where the anusvara/Vedic anusvara sign of triṃśat ("thirty") must stand; the word triṃśad-dhāma is required by the sense (thirty domains).

notes: dhāma is taken as neuter accusative plural (Vedic) "domains". pataṅga "bird" is commonly understood of the sun, but the line only says "bird". prati vastoḥ: "at each dawning"; aha is the emphatic particle. The subject of vi rājati is not stated in the line.
lines_deva: त्रि॒jशद्धाम॒ वि रा॑जति॒ वाक् प॑त॒ङ्गाय॑ धीयते । प्रति॒ वस्तो॒रह॒ द्युभि॑ः
lines_iast: tri̱jśaddhāma̱ vi rā̭jati̱ vāk pa̭ta̱ṅgāya̭ dhīyate | prati̱ vasto̱raha̱ dyubhi̭ḥ

hindi: अग्नि ज्योति है, ज्योति अग्नि है, स्वाहा। सूर्य ज्योति है, ज्योति सूर्य है, स्वाहा। अग्नि वर्चस् है, ज्योति वर्चस् है, स्वाहा। सूर्य वर्चस् है, ज्योति वर्चस् है, स्वाहा। ज्योति सूर्य है, सूर्य ज्योति है, स्वाहा।
english: Agni is light, light is Agni, svāhā. Sūrya is light, light is Sūrya, svāhā. Agni is splendour, light is splendour, svāhā. Sūrya is splendour, light is splendour, svāhā. Light is Sūrya, Sūrya is light, svāhā.
lines_deva: अ॒ग्निर्ज्योति॒र्ज्योति॑र॒ग्निः स्वाहा॑ । सूर्यो॒ ज्योति॒र्ज्योति॒ः सूर्य॒ः स्वाहा॑
अ॒ग्निर्वर्चो॒ ज्योति॒र्वर्चः॒ स्वाहा॑ । सूर्यो॒ वर्चो॒ ज्योति॒र्वर्चः॒ स्वाहा॑ । ज्योति॒ः सूर्य॒ः सूर्यो॒ ज्योति॒ः स्वाहा॑
lines_iast: a̱gnirjyoti̱rjyoti̭ra̱gniḥ svāhā̭ | sūryo̱ jyoti̱rjyoti̱ḥ sūrya̱ḥ svāhā̭

english: Together with the god Savitṛ, together with Night accompanied by Indra, may Agni, accepting, enjoy, svāhā. Together with the god Savitṛ, together with Dawn accompanied by Indra, may Sūrya, accepting, enjoy, svāhā.
notes: sajū rātryā: the visarga of sajūḥ is dropped before r by regular sandhi. In line 2 the danda and juṣāṇaḥ are printed without a space ("|jṷṣā̱ṇaḥ"); kept as one src token.
lines_deva: स॒जूर्दे॒वेन॑ सवि॒त्रा स॒जू रात्र्येन्द्र॑वत्या । जु॑षा॒णो अ॒ग्निर्वे॑तु॒ स्वाहा॑
स॒जूर्दे॒वेन॑ सवि॒त्रा स॒जूरु॒षसेन्द्र॑वत्या ।जु॑षा॒णः सूर्यो॑ वेतु॒ स्वाहा॑

sa̱jūrde̱vena̭ savi̱trā sa̱jūru̱ṣasendra̭vatyā |jṷṣā̱ṇaḥ sūryo̭ vetu̱ svāhā̭

hindi: यज्ञ के समीप जाते हुए हम अग्नि के लिए मन्त्र बोलें, जो दूर भी और हमारे बीच भी सुनता है।
english: Approaching the rite, may we speak a mantra to Agni, who hears afar and among us.
notes: asme is the Vedic locative/dative plural of the 1st person pronoun; taken as locative "among us".
lines_deva: उ॒प॒प्र॒यन्तो॑ अध्व॒रं मन्त्रं॑ वोचेमा॒ग्नये॑ । आ॒रे अ॒स्मे च॑ शृण्व॒ते
lines_iast: u̱pa̱pra̱yanto̭ adhva̱raṃ mantra̭ṃ vocemā̱gnayḙ | ā̱re a̱sme ca̭ śṛṇva̱te

hindi: अग्नि स्वर्ग का सिर है, शिखर है; यह पृथिवी का स्वामी है; यह जलों के बीजों को उत्तेजित करता है।
english: Agni is the head of heaven, the summit; this one is the lord of the earth; he quickens the seeds of the waters.
notes: kakut patiḥ written together: kakut "summit, peak" and patiḥ "lord" are separate words. pṛthivyā: the visarga of pṛthivyāḥ is dropped before a- by sandhi. ᳪ in src is the Vedic anusvara sign.
lines_deva: अ॒ग्निर्मू॒र्धा दि॒वः क॒कुत्पति॑ः पृथि॒व्या अ॒यम् । अ॒पाᳪरेता॑ᳪसि जिन्वति
lines_iast: a̱gnirmū̱rdhā di̱vaḥ ka̱kutpati̭ḥ pṛthi̱vyā a̱yam | a̱pāᳪretā̭ᳪsi jinvati

hindi: तुम दोनों इन्द्र और अग्नि को आह्वान के लिए, दोनों को दान के साथ आनन्दित होने के लिए; अन्न और धन के दोनों दाताओं को, तुम दोनों को बल की प्राप्ति के लिए मैं बुलाता हूँ।
english: Both of you, Indra and Agni, to invoke, both to delight together in the bounty; both the givers of refreshments and of riches, both of you I call for the winning of strength.
notes: āhuvadhyā u-: the final -ai of the infinitive āhuvadhyai becomes -ā before a vowel (Vedic sandhi). rādhasaḥ saha mādayadhyai: "to delight together in (with) the bounty"; the genitive is read with mādayadhyai. vāja may be "strength" or "booty".
lines_deva: उ॒भा वा॑मिन्द्राग्नी आहु॒वध्या॑ उ॒भा राध॑सः स॒ह मा॑द॒यध्यै॑
उ॒भा दा॒तारा॑वि॒षाᳪर॑यी॒णामु॒भा वाज॑स्य सा॒तये॑ हुवे वाम्
lines_iast: u̱bhā vā̭mindrāgnī āhu̱vadhyā̭ u̱bhā rādha̭saḥ sa̱ha mā̭da̱yadhyai̭
u̱bhā dā̱tārā̭vi̱ṣāᳪra̭yī̱ṇāmu̱bhā vāja̭sya sā̱tayḙ huve vām

hindi: यह तेरा समयोचित स्थान है, जिससे उत्पन्न होकर तू चमका; हे अग्नि, उसे जानता हुआ उस पर आरूढ़ हो, फिर हमारे धन को बढ़ा।
english: This is your timely seat, from which, born, you shone; knowing it, O Agni, mount it; then make our wealth grow.
notes: agna ā-: the voc. agne loses its final -e before ā- by sandhi. ārohāthā = ā roha atha with a + a > ā; vardhayā shows metrical lengthening of vardhaya. The final -ā of athā is likewise metrically lengthened (atha).
lines_deva: अ॒यं ते॒ योनि॑रृ॒त्वियो॒ यतो॑ जा॒तो अरो॑चथाः । तं जा॒नन्न॑ग्न॒ आरो॒हाथा॑ नो वर्धया र॒यिम्
lines_iast: a̱yaṃ te̱ yoni̭rṛ̱tviyo̱ yato̭ jā̱to aro̭cathāḥ | taṃ jā̱nanna̭gna̱ āro̱hāthā̭ no vardhayā ra̱yim

hindi: यह यहाँ स्थापकों द्वारा प्रथम स्थापित किया गया, होता, श्रेष्ठ याजक, यज्ञों में स्तुत्य; जिसे अप्नवान और भृगुओं ने वनों में प्रकाशित किया, उज्ज्वल, व्यापक, प्रत्येक प्रजा के लिए।
english: This one was here set first by the establishers as the hotṛ, best at sacrifice, to be praised at the rites; whom Apnavāna and the Bhṛgus made shine in the woods, bright, pervading, for every clan.
notes: apnavānaḥ is taken as a proper name (nom. sg.) coordinated with bhṛgavaḥ; vibhvam "pervading" or "mighty".
lines_deva: अ॒यमि॒ह प्र॑थ॒मो धा॑यि धा॒तृभि॒र्होता॒ यजि॑ष्ठो अध्व॒रेष्वीड्य॑ः
यमप्न॑वानो॒ भृग॑वो विरुरु॒चुर्वने॑षु चि॒त्रं वि॒भ्वं॒ वि॒शेवि॑शे
lines_iast: a̱yami̱ha pra̭tha̱mo dhā̭yi dhā̱tṛbhi̱rhotā̱ yaji̭ṣṭho adhva̱reṣvīḍya̭ḥ
yamapna̭vāno̱ bhṛga̭vo viruru̱curvanḙṣu ci̱traṃ vi̱bhva̱ṃ vi̱śevi̭śe

hindi: उसकी प्राचीन दीप्ति के अनुसार निर्भय लोगों ने उज्ज्वल दूध दुहा है, सहस्रों को जीतने वाले ऋषि को।
english: Following his ancient brilliance, the bold ones have milked the bright milk, the thousand-winning sage.
notes: payaḥ and ṛṣim are both accusatives with duduhre (the double accusative of √duh: to milk X from Y); dyutam is feminine "brilliance". The ᳪ sign in dyutaᳪ is the Vedic anusvara.
lines_deva: अ॒स्य प्र॒त्नामनु॒ द्युत॑ᳪशु॒क्रं दु॑दुह्रे॒ अह्र॑यः । पय॑ः सहस्र॒सामृषि॑म्
lines_iast: a̱sya pra̱tnāmanu̱ dyuta̭ᳪśu̱kraṃ dṷduhre̱ ahra̭yaḥ | paya̭ḥ sahasra̱sāmṛṣi̭m

hindi: हे अग्नि, तू शरीर का रक्षक है, मेरे शरीर की रक्षा कर। हे अग्नि, तू आयु देने वाला है, मुझे आयु दे। हे अग्नि, तू वर्चस् देने वाला है, मुझे वर्चस् दे। हे अग्नि, मेरे शरीर में जो कमी है, उसे मेरे लिए पूर्ण कर।
english: You are the body-protector, O Agni; protect my body. You are the life-giver, O Agni; give me life. You are the splendour-giver, O Agni; give me splendour. O Agni, what is lacking in my body, fill that up for me.
notes: a̭gne̱ syāyṷrme: agne + asi + āyuḥ + me, printed as "agne syāyur me" with the initial a- of asi elided after -e (the avagraha is not printed here, unlike agne'si in the same line). tanvā ūnam: the visarga of tanvāḥ is dropped before ū-.
lines_deva: त॑नू॒पा अ॑ग्नेऽसि त॒न्वं॒ मे पाह्यायु॒र्दा अ॑ग्ने॒ स्यायु॑र्मे देहि व॑र्चो॒दा अ॑ग्नेऽसि॒ वर्चो॑ मे देहि
अग्ने॒ यन्मे॑ त॒न्वा॒ ऊ॒नं तन्म॒ आपृ॑ण

agne̱ yanmḙ ta̱nvā̱ ū̱naṃ tanma̱ āpṛ̭ṇa

hindi: तुझे सौ वर्ष तक प्रज्वलित करते हुए, वीर्यवान, बलवान और अहिंसित हम, हे अग्नि, तुझ दीप्तिमान, वीर्य करने वाले, बल करने वाले, शत्रुओं के नाशक और अहिंस्य को प्रज्वलित करें। हे विचित्र धन वाले, तेरे कल्याण से मैं पार पहुँचूँ।
english: Kindling you for a hundred winters, may we, full of vigour, full of might and unharmed, kindle you, O Agni: the brilliant one, the vigour-maker, the might-maker, the crusher of rivals, the one who cannot be harmed. O you of bright wealth, with your well-being may I reach the far shore.

text_flags.why: possible: the sense and the parallel sahaskṛtam require the accusative vayaskṛtam (object of samidhīmahi, like dyumantam, sahaskṛtam, adābhyam); the printed form lacks the final anusvara.

notes: dyumantam, vayaskṛtam, sahaskṛtam, sapatnadambhanam and adābhyam are accusative epithets of tvā (Agni), the object of samidhīmahi 'may we kindle'; the nominative plurals (vayasvantaḥ, sahasvantaḥ, adabdhāsaḥ) qualify 'we'. svasti is taken adverbially ('with well-being'); te 'your'. Flag on vayaskṛta stays "possible"; the printed form may be the edition's own reading; check a printed edition.
lines_deva: इन्धा॑नास्त्वा श॒तᳪहिमा॑ द्यु॒मन्त॒ᳪसमि॑धीमहि । वय॑स्वन्तो वय॒स्कृत॒ सह॑स्वन्तः सह॒स्कृत॑म्
अग्ने॑ सपत्न॒दम्भ॑न॒मद॑ब्धासो॒ अदा॑भ्यम् । चित्रा॑वसो स्व॒स्ति ते॑ पा॒रम॑शीय
lines_iast: indhā̭nāstvā śa̱taᳪhimā̭ dyu̱manta̱ᳪsami̭dhīmahi | vaya̭svanto vaya̱skṛta̱ saha̭svantaḥ saha̱skṛta̭m
agnḙ sapatna̱dambha̭na̱mada̭bdhāso̱ adā̭bhyam | citrā̭vaso sva̱sti tḙ pā̱rama̭śīya

hindi: हे अग्नि, तू सूर्य के वर्चस् के साथ, ऋषियों की स्तुति के साथ संयुक्त हुआ है; मैं प्रिय धाम के साथ, आयु के साथ, वर्चस् के साथ, प्रजा के साथ, धन की पुष्टि के साथ संयुक्त होऊँ।
english: You, O Agni, have united with the splendour of Sūrya, with the praise of the sages; may I unite with the dear abode, I with life, with splendour, with offspring, with increase of wealth.
notes: sam ... agathāḥ and sam ... gmiṣīya: the preverb sam goes with the verb each time. Two src tokens end in the Vedic anusvara sign followed by a double space (samṛṣīṇāᳪ , saᳪ ); the extra space is kept in src. dhāman may be "abode" or "splendour, nature".
lines_deva: सं त्वम॑ग्ने॒ सूर्य॑स्य॒ वर्च॑सागथा॒ः समृषी॑णाᳪ  स्तु॒तेन॑
सं प्रि॒येण॒ धाम्ना॒ सम॒हमायु॑षा॒ सं वर्च॑सा॒ सं प्र॒जया॒ सᳪ  रा॒यस्पोषे॑ण ग्मिषीय
lines_iast: saṃ tvama̭gne̱ sūrya̭sya̱ varca̭sāgathā̱ḥ samṛṣī̭ṇāᳪ  stu̱tena̭
saṃ pri̱yeṇa̱ dhāmnā̱ sama̱hamāyṷṣā̱ saṃ varca̭sā̱ saṃ pra̱jayā̱ saᳪ  rā̱yaspoṣḙṇa gmiṣīya

hindi: तुम अन्न हो, मैं तुम्हारे अन्न का भोग करूँ। तुम महत्ता हो, मैं तुम्हारी महत्ता का भोग करूँ। तुम ऊर्जा हो, मैं तुम्हारी ऊर्जा का भोग करूँ। तुम धन की पुष्टि हो, मैं तुम्हारी धन की पुष्टि का भोग करूँ।
english: You are food; may I partake of your food. You are greatness; may I partake of your greatness. You are vigour; may I partake of your vigour. You are increase of wealth; may I partake of your increase of wealth.
notes: andha stha, maha stha, ūrja stha, rāyaspoṣa stha: the visarga of the nominative is dropped before sth- by sandhi. ūrja is taken as the masculine noun ūrja "vigour" (nom. ūrjaḥ, acc. ūrjam); alternatively the consonant stem ūrj.
lines_deva: अन्ध॒ स्थान्धो॑ वो भक्षीय॒ मह॑ स्थ॒ महो॑ वो भक्षी॒योर्ज॒ स्थोर्जं॑ वो भक्षीय रा॒यस्पोष॑ स्थ रा॒यस्पोषं॑ वो भक्षीय
lines_iast: andha̱ sthāndho̭ vo bhakṣīya̱ maha̭ stha̱ maho̭ vo bhakṣī̱yorja̱ sthorja̭ṃ vo bhakṣīya rā̱yaspoṣa̭ stha rā̱yaspoṣa̭ṃ vo bhakṣīya

hindi: हे धनवतियो, इस स्थान में, इस गोष्ठ में, इस लोक में, इस निवास में रमो; यहीं रहो, दूर मत जाओ।
english: O rich ones, abide in this seat, in this cow-pen, in this world, in this dwelling; stay right here; do not go away.
notes: revatī ramadhvam: the visarga of the voc. pl. revatīḥ is dropped before r-. The feminine plural addressees are not named in the line (the cows, by context of goṣṭha, but the text only says "rich ones"). mā apagāta: injunctive with mā.
lines_deva: रेव॑ती॒ रम॑ध्वम॒स्मिन्योना॑व॒स्मिन् गो॒ष्ठेऽस्मिंल्लो॒के॒ऽस्मिन्क्षये॑ । इहै॒व स्त॒ माप॑गात
lines_iast: reva̭tī̱ rama̭dhvama̱sminyonā̭va̱smin go̱ṣṭhe'smiṃllo̱ke̱'sminkṣayḙ | ihai̱va sta̱ māpa̭gāta

hindi: तू संहित है, विश्वरूपिणी है; ऊर्जा के साथ, गोपति-भाव के साथ मुझमें प्रवेश कर। हे अग्नि, हे अन्धकार को प्रकाशित करने वाले, दिन-दिन हम बुद्धि के साथ, नमस्कार लिए हुए, तेरे पास आते हैं।
english: You are united, of all forms; with vigour enter into me, with lordship over cows. To you, O Agni, day by day, O illuminer of darkness, we come with prayer, bearing homage.
notes: doṣāvastar: voc. of doṣā-vastṛ, "illuminer of the night/darkness"; the printed -rddh- (doṣāvastarddhiyā) is the usual doubling after r. ema̭si = ā + imasi (Vedic 1 pl. of √i). The first half (saṃhitāsi ... gaupatyena) is addressed to a feminine being; the line does not name her. The sense of doṣāvastar is disputed; 'illuminer of darkness' follows one reading, another takes it as 'by night and by day'.
lines_deva: स॒ᳪहि॒तासि॑ विश्वरू॒प्यू॒र्जा मावि॑श गौप॒त्येन॑ । उप॑ त्वाग्ने दि॒वेदि॑वे॒ दोषा॑वस्तर्द्धि॒या व॒यम्
नमो॒ भर॑न्त॒ एम॑सि
lines_iast: sa̱ᳪhi̱tāsi̭ viśvarū̱pyū̱rjā māvi̭śa gaupa̱tyena̭ | upa̭ tvāgne di̱vedi̭ve̱ doṣā̭vastarddhi̱yā va̱yam
namo̱ bhara̭nta̱ ema̭si

words.gram: m. acc. sg. pres. part. mid. √vṛdh

hindi: यज्ञों पर शासन करने वाले, ऋत के दीप्तिमान रक्षक, अपने घर में बढ़ते हुए को।
english: Ruling over the rites, the shining guardian of truth, growing in his own house.
notes: GROUPING: the accusatives of this unit continue the sentence of unit 22 (upa tvāgne ... emasi); the edition numbers it separately and that grouping is kept. gopām ṛtasya: visarga-less sandhi of gopām + ṛtasya is regular.
lines_deva: राज॑न्तमध्व॒राणां॑ गो॒पामृ॒तस्य॒ दीदि॑विम् । वर्ध॑मान॒ᳪ स्वे दमे॑
lines_iast: rāja̭ntamadhva̱rāṇā̭ṃ go̱pāmṛ̱tasya̱ dīdi̭vim | vardha̭māna̱ᳪ sve damḙ

hindi: हे अग्नि, जैसे पिता पुत्र के लिए, वैसे तू हमारे लिए सुलभ हो; कल्याण के लिए हमारे साथ रह।
english: As a father to a son, O Agni, be easy of access to us; stay with us for well-being.
notes: sacasvā shows metrical lengthening of sacasva. saḥ with the imperative bhava: "you, (being) he".
lines_deva: स न॑ः पि॒तेव॑ सू॒नवेऽग्ने॑ सूपाय॒नो भ॑व । सच॑स्वा नः स्व॒स्तये॑
lines_iast: sa na̭ḥ pi̱teva̭ sū̱nave'gnḙ sūpāya̱no bha̭va | saca̭svā naḥ sva̱stayḙ

hindi: हे अग्नि, तू हमारा सबसे निकट और त्राता हो, कल्याणकारी, आश्रय देने वाला हो; अग्नि वसु है, उत्तम यश वाला है; इधर आ, अत्यन्त दीप्तिमान धन दे।
english: O Agni, be our nearest one and a protector, kindly and sheltering; Agni is good, of good renown; come hither; give most brilliant wealth.
notes: antama u-: the visarga of antamaḥ is dropped before u-; vasuśravā a-: likewise before a-. bhavā, acchā show metrical lengthening. dāḥ: injunctive used as imperative. The double space after dyumattamaᳪ is kept in src.
lines_deva: अग्ने॒ त्वं नो॒ अन्त॑म उ॒त त्रा॒ता शि॒वो भ॑वा वरू॒थ्य॒ः
वसु॑र॒ग्निर्वसुश्र॑वा॒ अच्छा॑ नक्षि द्यु॒मत्त॑मᳪ  र॒यिं दा॑ः
lines_iast: agne̱ tvaṃ no̱ anta̭ma u̱ta trā̱tā śi̱vo bha̭vā varū̱thya̱ḥ
vasṷra̱gnirvasuśra̭vā̱ acchā̭ nakṣi dyu̱matta̭maᳪ  ra̱yiṃ dā̭ḥ

words.gloss: from one who seeks to harm

hindi: हे अतिदीप्त, हे प्रकाशमान, उस तुझसे हम अब मित्रों के लिए कृपा की याचना करते हैं; तू हमारी ओर ध्यान दे, हमारी पुकार सुन, हमें हर एक अहित चाहने वाले से बचा।
english: You, O most brilliant, O shining one, we now beseech for favour, for the friends; take notice of us, hear our call, protect us from every one who seeks to harm.

text_flags.why: possible: "adhāyataḥ" gives no sense here; the context (uruṣya "protect ... from") requires aghāyataḥ "from one who intends harm" (denominative of agha); the Devanagari अधा for अघा is a one-letter slip (ध/घ).

notes: śrudhī and uruṣyā show metrical lengthening; ṇo = naḥ with retroflexion after uruṣyā. īmahe: 1 pl. middle of the root ī "to beseech, implore".
lines_deva: तं त्वा॑ शोचिष्ठ दीदिवः सु॒म्नाय॑ नू॒नमी॑महे॒ सखि॑भ्यः
स नो॑ बोधि श्रु॒धी हव॑मुरु॒ष्या णो॑ अधाय॒तः सम॑स्मात्
lines_iast: taṃ tvā̭ śociṣṭha dīdivaḥ su̱mnāya̭ nū̱namī̭mahe̱ sakhi̭bhyaḥ
sa no̭ bodhi śru̱dhī hava̭muru̱ṣyā ṇo̭ adhāya̱taḥ sama̭smāt

hindi: हे इडा, आ; हे अदिति, आ; हे कमनीयो, आओ। तुम्हारी कामनाओं का धारण मुझमें हो।
english: O Iḍā, come; O Aditi, come; O desirable ones, come. May the holding of your desires be in me.
notes: iḍa ehi, adita ehi: the final -e of the vocatives iḍe, adite becomes -a before e- (Vedic sandhi); ehi = ā + ihi, eta = ā + ita. kāma-dharaṇam "holding/retaining of desire" is translated literally.
lines_deva: इड॒ एह्यदि॑त॒ एहि॑ काम्या॒ एत॑ । मयि॑ वः काम॒धर॑णं भूयात्
lines_iast: iḍa̱ ehyadi̭ta̱ ehi̭ kāmyā̱ eta̭ | mayi̭ vaḥ kāma̱dhara̭ṇaṃ bhūyāt

hindi: हे ब्रह्मणस्पति, सोम निचोड़ने वाले को यशस्वी बना, कक्षीवान् को, जो उशिज का पुत्र है।
english: O Brahmaṇaspati, make the Soma-presser resounding, Kakṣīvat who is the son of Uśij (read as apposition or as a comparison; see note).
notes: kakṣīvantam: a second object of kṛṇuhi, read as a comparison ("as Kakṣīvat"); the line itself only coordinates the two accusatives. ya au-: yaḥ before au- loses its visarga. The double space after somānaᳪ is kept in src.
lines_deva: सो॒मान॒ᳪ  स्वर॑णं कृणु॒हि ब्र॑ह्मणस्पते । क॒क्षीव॑न्तं॒ य औ॑शि॒जः
lines_iast: so̱māna̱ᳪ  svara̭ṇaṃ kṛṇu̱hi bra̭hmaṇaspate | ka̱kṣīva̭nta̱ṃ ya aṷśi̱jaḥ

hindi: जो धनवान है, जो रोगों का नाश करने वाला है, धन का ज्ञाता है, पुष्टि को बढ़ाने वाला है, जो शीघ्रगामी है, वह हमारे साथ रहे।
english: He who is wealthy, who is the disease-slayer, the wealth-finder, the increaser of prosperity, who is swift, let him attend us.
notes: puṣṭivarddhanaḥ: -rddh- is the usual doubling after r (= vardhanaḥ). siṣaktu is the Vedic reduplicated imperative of √sac.
lines_deva: यो रे॒वान्यो अ॑मीव॒हा व॑सु॒वित्पु॑ष्टि॒वर्द्ध॑नः । स न॑ः सिषक्तु॒ यस्तु॒रः
lines_iast: yo re̱vānyo a̭mīva̱hā va̭su̱vitpṷṣṭi̱varddha̭naḥ | sa na̭ḥ siṣaktu̱ yastu̱raḥ

hindi: हमें न तो शत्रुतापूर्ण का शाप और न मर्त्य की दुष्टता पहुँचे; हे ब्रह्मणस्पति, हमारी रक्षा कर।
english: Let not the curse of the hostile one, nor the malice of a mortal, reach us; protect us, O Brahmaṇaspati.

text_flags.why: the Devanagari प्रण॒ङ lacks the virama: the form is praṇak (aor. inj. of pra-√naś) with k > ṅ before the following m- of martyasya; "praṇaṅa" with a final vowel is not a word.

notes: araruṣaḥ: gen. sg. of ararivas/araru "not giving, hostile" (of the demon or the niggard); ṇo = naḥ with retroflexion after rakṣā; rakṣā shows metrical lengthening. The ᳪ in śaᳪso is the Vedic anusvara sign.
lines_deva: मा न॒ः शᳪसो॒ अर॑रुषो धू॒र्तिः प्रण॒ङ मर्त्य॑स्य । रक्षा॑ णो ब्रह्मणस्पते
lines_iast: mā na̱ḥ śaᳪso̱ ara̭ruṣo dhū̱rtiḥ praṇa̱ṅa martya̭sya | rakṣā̭ ṇo brahmaṇaspate

hindi: तीनों की — मित्र की, अर्यमा की, वरुण की — महान, स्वर्गीय, दुर्धर्ष सहायता हो।
english: Great be the help of the three, heavenly, of Mitra and of Aryaman, hard to assail, of Varuṇa.
notes: avo 'stu: the visarga of avaḥ becomes o before the elided a- of astu.
lines_deva: महि॑ त्री॒णामवो॑ऽस्तु द्यु॒क्षं मि॒त्रस्या॑र्य॒म्णः । दु॑रा॒धर्षं॒ वरु॑णस्य
lines_iast: mahi̭ trī̱ṇāmavo̭'stu dyu̱kṣaṃ mi̱trasyā̭rya̱mṇaḥ | dṷrā̱dharṣa̱ṃ varṷṇasya

hindi: क्योंकि न तो घर में और न ही भयंकर मार्गों पर पाप की बात करने वाला शत्रु उन पर अधिकार रखता है।
english: For neither at home nor on dangerous roads does the evil-speaking enemy have power over them.
notes: teṣām: genitive with īśe ("has power over them"); the antecedent is not stated in this line. vāraṇa "dangerous, wild"; amā cana ... na "neither at home ... nor".
lines_deva: न॒हि तेषा॑म॒मा च॒न नाध्व॑सु वार॒णेषु॑ । ईशे॑ रि॒पुर॒घश॑ᳪसः
lines_iast: na̱hi teṣā̭ma̱mā ca̱na nādhva̭su vāra̱ṇeṣṷ | īśḙ ri̱pura̱ghaśa̭ᳪsaḥ
